title: Request bracelet enlargement
intro: The business must assess actual compatible links, a strap or supported clasp adjustment. A measurement is not final fit approval.
pending: The result is uncertain. Keep this reference and retry the same request.
saved: Request recorded. Assessment is still required.
denied: Access denied. Sign in with the permitted account and reopen this record.
stale: The record changed. Reopen it and review the current assessment before trying again.
error: Unavailable. Your request is not confirmed. Retry with the same reference.
empty: No assessment yet. The business will confirm compatible parts, cost and target fit.
waiting: Waiting for compatible parts. Contact the business for the next review or a newly assessed alternative.
accept: Accept the displayed quote and its mandatory and selected optional lines
accepted: Accepted scope recorded. Work still requires current custody, approval and confirmed held payment.
terms: Review the complete quote and terms with the business before acceptance.
termsCheck: I reviewed all displayed mandatory and chosen optional lines and the exact terms.
actionPending: Action outcome uncertain. Retry the same action before making another change.
rework: The fit or tests failed. The business must record corrective work and obtain another independent check.
invalid: Correct the entered details and submit again.
